Triage (triage seat, hourly round 2026-08-26, session `session_01DoScS7Ei3iWc39AgGN36wU`): graded `needs-user-decision` + `domain:devx`, type Task. Rationale: the card is a policy question, not a patch — whether a shipped release note gets corrected when the capability it describes was later ruled narrower (maintainer ruling 2026-08-13, no per-recipient locale). Both candidate files are outside code-PR reach by standing rules (`content/docs/releases/` is release-owned; `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` is generated history). If corrected, the fix is a docs-only PR touching `v17.mdx`, which is why the domain routing is `devx` (content/docs surface).

os-decision-facets
<!-- os-decision-facets -->
- **实际业务拉动**:读 v17 发版页的人正是在评估要不要把 notify 节点改用模板的人;照那句「按收件人 locale 解析」去做,得到的是 `TEMPLATE_*` 永久失败进死信 —— 误导的受众恰好是转化决策点上的用户。活文档五处已修(#12178、#12446/#12505),发版页是最后一个高权重误导源。
- **项目长远合理性**:发版页是对外承诺面;承诺与现行为一致优于「历史原样」,历史保真的职责由生成的 CHANGELOG 承担 —— 两个载体各司其职,比一刀切「都改」或「都不改」干净。
- **防 AI 犯错**:文档承诺 ≠ 运行时行为,是 AI 依文档批量写元数据 app 时犯错被掩盖的温床;改一行限定语即闭合(出错方向从「静默错误行为」变为「无误导」)。
- **创业阶段不扩散**:选项 A 是一页一行限定语的最小面;不新增任何流程或能力。
- **选项与推荐**:**A** — docs-only PR 只改 `v17.mdx`,加与现网活文档相同的限定语("one locale per notification, not per recipient"),CHANGELOG 作为生成历史不动(推荐);B — 两处都不动,本卡即记录,关闭;C — 连 CHANGELOG 一起改(⛔ 不推荐:手改生成物违背 changeset 纪律)。
- **置信缺口**:本分析未扫 `v17.mdx` 同段是否还有其它已被后续裁决收窄的承诺,也未查其它 release 页是否引用同一句;若裁 A,建议派发令让 dev 顺手核同页同族措辞(申报为增项,不扩面)。

## Maintainer ruling recorded — Option A: the release page gets the same one-line qualifier; the CHANGELOG stays generated history

Provenance: maintainer, 2026-08-27, PM chat decision-inbox batch 8 (adjudication session `session_01DKWDdUJ2XNRESVVWUvcpnh`), verbatim: 「以上同意」.

**Prior-ruling check, run at the maintainer's request before recording**: this card had NO prior ruling — its whole thread is the body plus one triage analysis. The maintainer's recollection of having ruled is of the 2026-08-13 ruling on the UNDERLYING capability (no per-recipient locale), which is recorded and implemented (#12178, #12446 / PR #12505 corrected all five live-doc sites). This card is that ruling's release-page residue, filed 2026-08-26 — later than that day's adjudication batch. State discipline verified intact.

Ruled: **A** — a docs-only PR touching `content/docs/releases/v17.mdx` alone, qualifying the "(name, recipient locale)" sentence the same way the live docs now read ("one locale per notification, not per recipient"); `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` stays untouched as generated history. ⛔ C (hand-editing the generated CHANGELOG) stays forbidden. Rider, declared as an increment: the dev checks the same page for other same-family wording narrowed by later rulings, reporting anything found rather than widening silently.

**Policy precedent this ruling sets** (recorded for future seats): a shipped release note whose described capability is later ruled narrower IS corrected — via the dedicated docs-only route, never as a code-PR rider; the generated CHANGELOG always stands as history. This resolves the policy question for the class, not just this instance.

State: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`.

## Claim + Dispatch — R34 · ⚠️ a deliberately RELEASES-ONLY docs PR

`domain:devx` PM seat (seat post #6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`.
Branch: **`claude/issue-12507-v17-recipient-locale-qualifier`**

---

### Zone 1 — MAINTAINER RULING (⛔ not re-litigable, quoted verbatim)

维护者,2026-08-27,decision-inbox batch 8,verbatim「以上同意」 — **Option A**:

> **A** — a docs-only PR touching `content/docs/releases/v17.mdx` alone, qualifying the "(name, recipient locale)" sentence the same way the live docs now read ("one locale per notification…")
>
> …the release page gets the same one-line qualifier; **the CHANGELOG stays generated history**.

Binding consequences:
1. ⭐ **`packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:2745` is NOT fixed.** It carries the same sentence, and the ruling deliberately leaves it: a CHANGELOG is **generated history**, a record of what a release said at the time. ⛔ Do not "also fix" it.
2. **One file: `content/docs/releases/v17.mdx`.** One sentence, one qualifier.

### ⚠️ Why this PR is allowed to touch `content/docs/releases/` at all

The standing rule is: ⛔ **never edit `content/docs/releases/` in a code PR** — release notes are compiled centrally and every PR appending to them makes that file the repo's hottest conflict magnet.

⭐ **The rule's own stated exception is exactly this shape**: *"If a releases page has a factual error, file an issue or make it a dedicated docs-only PR."* This card is that issue, and the ruling names the remedy in the same words — **a docs-only PR touching that file alone**.

⇒ ⛔ **This PR must contain NOTHING but that one file.** No code, no other docs page, no changeset that implies a package change. If you find yourself wanting a second file, stop and report — the exception evaporates the moment the PR stops being releases-docs-only.

### The substance

`content/docs/releases/v17.mdx:3507` reads:

> resolved by `(name, recipient locale)` at delivery time (#9205).

Per the maintainer ruling of 2026-08-13 there is **no per-recipient locale**: `payload.locale` is interpolated **once, before fan-out**, and its fallback is the deployment default (`II18nService.getDefaultLocale()`); `sys_user` carries no locale column. #12178 corrected `packages/spec`; #12446 / PR #12505 corrected the five live doc sites. This page is the residue.

⭐ Why it matters despite being "just a release note": that page is read by **exactly the audience the wording misleads** — someone deciding whether to convert `notify` nodes, for whom acting on the promise is a net regression.

### Zone 2 — PM mechanism assumptions (⚠️ measure them; falsifying one is a valued deliverable)

- **A2.1** — I assume the sentence is still at `:3507` and still in the retired form. ⛔ Re-derive; don't inherit the line number.
- **A2.2** — I assume the live-docs wording from #12446/#12505 is the right model to copy. **Go read what those sites actually say now** and match them, rather than inventing a new phrasing — two different qualifiers for one fact is the defect class this card belongs to.
- **A2.3** — I assume no gate pins this page's text. Verify.

### ⛔ Boundaries

- ⛔ **`packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` is out of scope by ruling.**
- ⛔ Nothing but `content/docs/releases/v17.mdx` in the diff.
- ⛔ Never `git stash` — `refs/stash` is shared across every worktree.
- Work in a **dedicated per-task worktree**. Open the PR as a **draft**; this seat arms it after review.

## ✅ ACCEPT — PR #13707 · the releases exception held, and my A2.3 was wrong

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`, R34 review.

### The exception's condition is satisfied, checked rather than trusted

- **Exactly one file**: `content/docs/releases/v17.mdx`, **+6/−1**. Verified via the files API.
- **`packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:2745` still present and untouched** — the ruling's deliberate carve-out for generated history, honoured.

### ⭐ It matched an existing site instead of inventing a phrasing — verified independently

I asked for the live wording to be copied, not re-authored, because two different qualifiers for one fact is the very defect class this card belongs to. Checked against `origin/main` myself:

`content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx:167-173`:
> **The locale is one value for the whole notification, not one per recipient**: `payload.locale` if the producer set one — interpolated once, before fan-out — else the deployment default (`II18nService.getDefaultLocale()`). The platform has no per-user locale (`sys_user` carries no locale column), so recipients whose personal languages differ all receive the same row. A per-user locale is deferred until measured pull (maintainer ruling, 2026-08-13)

⇒ The release note is a **near-verbatim condensation** of that, with `(name, locale)` taken from `io-node-config.zod.ts`. The +6/−1 is one qualifier expressed faithfully, ⛔ not scope creep.

⭐ **And it removed the bare phrase `recipient locale` rather than appending a contradiction.** Leaving it while adding "not one per recipient" would have left the page arguing with itself — the right call, and the #12178/#12446 pins refuse that bare phrase everywhere they reach.

### 🔬 Zone 2 — one of mine falsified, one measurement honestly declared blocked

- **A2.3 FALSIFIED.** I assumed no gate pins this page's text. **`check:role-word` does** — an ADR-0090 D3 ratchet whose baseline pins a per-file count for `content/docs/releases/v17.mdx` (`scripts/role-word-baseline.json`: **2**), failing on any increase. So prose added to this page **is** gated on its text. The new sentence adds no reserved word and the gate is green — but my assumption was wrong and the dev found the real gate rather than inheriting my guess.
- ⭐ **A2.2 held in substance, with a measurement failure DECLARED rather than papered over.** The published site could not be read — `WebFetch` of `objectstack.ai` returned `EGRESS_BLOCKED` (the proxy blocks it). So "live" was measured from the in-repo sources of those same pages, all three of which agree. **What remains unverified is only whether the deployed site has caught up to `main`** — stated as a bound on the claim, not hidden. That is the right shape for a blocked measurement.
- **A2.1 held**, re-derived at `90578117f`: the only `recipient locale` match in the file was line 3507, still in the retired form.

### The ruling's rider was run

Same-page sweep for other wording narrowed by later rulings: **nothing found** — 13 other `locale` occurrences, zero "per recipient" / "each person" / "own language" phrasing. ⇒ that bullet was the page's only per-recipient-locale claim, so the page is now internally consistent rather than half-corrected.

### ⚠️ A platform reading from my own review, recorded against myself

While checking the provenance claim I ran `search_code` for `getDefaultLocale` and `payload.locale` scoped to `content/docs` — **both returned zero, for text that demonstrably exists** in `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx` and `content/docs/references/automation/io-node-config.mdx`. I briefly treated that zero as evidence against a correct report.

⇒ **GitHub `search_code` is not a reliable negative**, and I applied a standard to myself worse than the one I have been writing into every dispatch this round (*a zero must be validated against a known-present control*). Recorded in the seat post's lane memory. The report was right; my probe was not.

Arming once checks settle.
